# WorldData.info

> > Comprehensive global statistics and data covering country demographics, climate, energy, economics, and international comparisons across all continents.

WorldData.info provides detailed country profiles and comparative statistics on topics including population dynamics, climate patterns (using WMO data), energy consumption and CO₂ emissions, economic indicators, refugee movements, and infrastructure metrics. Data is presented with international comparisons (often vs USA) and historical trends spanning multiple decades.

## Key Topics

- Country demographics and population statistics
- Climate data and weather patterns (WMO)
- Energy consumption and CO₂ emissions
- Time zones and UTC offsets
- Daylight saving time changes
- Refugee and asylum statistics
- Economic indicators and inflation
- Temperature and precipitation data
- International comparisons (vs USA)
- Public debt and budget deficits
- Healthcare systems
- Telecommunication infrastructure
- Education and literacy rates
- Sunrise and sunset times
- Regional climate zones

## Global Statistics and Rankings

- [Refugee countries and asylum data](https://www.worlddata.info/refugees-by-country.php): Global refugee statistics 2024: top origin/destination countries (UNHCR)
- [List of the 36 Heavily Indebted Poor Countries](https://www.worlddata.info/heavily-indebted-poor-countries.php): 36 HIPC countries requiring debt relief: IMF/G8 classification and aid

## Country Profiles

- [Dominica: country data and statistics](https://www.worlddata.info/america/dominica/index.php): Dominica overview: demographics, economy, energy, geography in Caribbean
- [Bolivia: country data and statistics](https://www.worlddata.info/america/bolivia/index.php): Bolivia overview: demographics, economy, climate in landlocked South America

## Economic and Financial Data

- [Inflation rates in the United Kingdom](https://www.worlddata.info/europe/united-kingdom/inflation-rates.php): UK inflation rates over 65 years: CPI, energy, food prices vs USA
- [Debts an budget deficits in Algeria](https://www.worlddata.info/africa/algeria/debt.php): Algeria public debt $129B: 8-year budget deficit trends vs EU average

## Energy and Environment

- [Energy and CO₂ in the United Arab Emirates](https://www.worlddata.info/asia/arab-emirates/energy-consumption.php): UAE energy consumption, production, CO₂ emissions vs USA (EDGAR data)
- [Energy and CO₂ in Belgium](https://www.worlddata.info/europe/belgium/energy-consumption.php): Belgium energy budget, CO₂ emissions, renewables vs USA comparison

## Demographics and Social Indicators

- [Population growth in Bulgaria](https://www.worlddata.info/europe/bulgaria/populationgrowth.php): Bulgaria population decline over 64 years: birth/death rates trends
- [Healthcare in the Netherlands](https://www.worlddata.info/europe/netherlands/health.php): Netherlands healthcare system stats and Western Europe comparison
- [Education in Burkina Faso](https://www.worlddata.info/africa/burkina-faso/education.php): Burkina Faso education stats: literacy, schooling, UNESCO rankings
- [Telecommunication in Belize](https://www.worlddata.info/america/belize/telecommunication.php): Belize telecom stats vs USA: internet speed, broadband, mobile phones
- [Refugees from Australia](https://www.worlddata.info/oceania/australia/asylum.php): Australia refugee outflows 2024: 43 asylum applications by destination

## Climate and Weather Data

- [Climate: South Australia](https://www.worlddata.info/oceania/australia/climate-south-australia.php): South Australia climate data: temps, rain, sunshine from 7 stations
- [Climate: Minas Gerais in Brazil](https://www.worlddata.info/america/brazil/climate-minas-gerais.php): Minas Gerais climate data: temperature, rain, sunshine from 4 stations
- [Climate: Abu Dhabi in the United Arab Emirates](https://www.worlddata.info/asia/arab-emirates/climate-abu-dhabi.php): Abu Dhabi climate: temperature, humidity, rainfall, water temp (WMO)

## Time Zones and Astronomy

- [Time zone and DST in the Bahamas](https://www.worlddata.info/america/bahamas/timezones.php): Bahamas timezone info: Eastern Standard Time (UTC-5) with DST changes
- [Time zone and DST in Bosnia and Herzegovina](https://www.worlddata.info/europe/bosnia-and-herzegovina/timezones.php): Bosnia and Herzegovina timezone: Central European Time (UTC+1) with DST
- [Time zone and DST in Bulgaria](https://www.worlddata.info/europe/bulgaria/timezones.php): Bulgaria timezone: Eastern European Time (UTC+2) with DST changes
- [Sunrise and sunset in Algeria](https://www.worlddata.info/africa/algeria/sunset.php): Algeria sunrise/sunset times for major cities with daylight hours
